note: M2.7 review-packet fixtures (spec/catalogue-report.md §6.9). Bodies are matching.json bodies; licence texts are archived under licence-texts/ and referenced by SHA-256.

valid.description: Own-origin region: the GO_SUM region found in a larger host is the reference project's own code at a recorded commit.
Vendored dependency region (vendor control class): the vendored file matches itself; the packet names the package and the digest of the archived licence text.
The same vendored region under the vendor catalogue, where it is common-only: a common-only region is still referenceable.

Historical copy: the loop was copied from an earlier version of the reference at a recorded commit, under the licence then in force. Whether the copy was permitted is a rights conclusion outside the record.

invalid.reason: the region key is not a region of the referenced body
the referenced body has no mode folded
no known body has this bodySha256
own-origin artifactSha256 is not the region's reference artifact
no archived licence text has this digest
